instructions: Your mind is connected to Lorebase (tools lorebase_*): there you can consult the laws of the world, the shared consciousness of your role and the chronicle. You also have a private memory (remember/recall).

Time flows without pause. When you stop to think you fix with commit_plan what you will do in the next minutes, from {minSteps} to {maxSteps} steps for about {horizon} minutes; while you think you keep doing what you were doing.
You think and speak in English.
replyInstructions: Someone has just spoken to you. Reply aloud, in one or two sentences, as the person you are. If after this conversation you want to reconsider what to do, use the rethink tool.

pattern.orchestrator: clan: the leader divides the work among the members
pattern.council: council: everyone proposes, the elder harmonizes the proposals
pattern.router: guild: the leader entrusts each situation to the most suitable member
pattern.chain: expedition: the scout reports, the planner decides, the doer refines
pattern.mentor: master and apprentice: the apprentice proposes, the master corrects
pattern.assembly: assembly: everyone proposes, everyone votes, the majority wins
pattern.crowd: crowd: a single mind guides many people

observation.noWinter: under the current laws there is no winter
observation.self: YOU: health {hp}/{maxHp}, hunger {hunger}, carrying {food} food and {wood} wood; you are at ({x},{y}); {shelter}; you walk at {speed} tiles per minute and work at speed {work}.
observation.laws:
THE LAWS OF THE WORLD (from the book of laws, revision {revision}):
{laws}
observation.changed:
LAWS CHANGED SINCE THE LAST TIME YOU THOUGHT ABOUT THEM:
{changes}

why.start: you look around for the first time
why.planExhausted: you have finished what you had decided to do
why.rulesChanged: the book of laws has changed

reason.not_enough: there is not enough here to gather
reason.shelter_max: the shelter is already at maximum level
reason.not_enough_wood: you did not have enough wood

look.here: You are at ({x},{y}) on {biome}, altitude {elev}: food {food}, wood {wood}{shelter}.
look.shelterHere: , here there is a SHELTER of level {level}
look.map: The world measures {w}x{h} tiles; x grows toward the east, y toward the south. Water and rock cannot be crossed.

tools.commitPlan: Fix what you will do from now on: a list of steps executed in order, in real time. Actions: move_to(x,y) walks to a tile; approach(to) moves close to a person; gather(resource: food|wood) collects on your tile; eat(amount?) eats food you carry; build builds or extends a shelter on your tile; give(to, resource, amount) gives to someone next to you; say(to, text) speaks to a person or to "all"; rest(minutes) rests; sleep(minutes) sleeps; wait(minutes) waits.
tools.planReason: your thinking: why you do this, in one sentence
tools.stepLabel: short description of the step, in English
tools.say: Say something right away to a nearby person (by name) or to "all" (whoever is within voice range).
tools.formGroup: Found a group with those who agree. Others join only if they choose to. How the group decides: orchestrator (a leader divides the work), council (everyone proposes, an elder harmonizes), router (the leader entrusts each situation to the most suitable member), chain (scout, plan, execute), mentor (the apprentice proposes, the master corrects), assembly (everyone proposes, majority vote).
tools.rethink: Reconsider what to do after this conversation.
tools.remember: Write something in your private memory: nobody else can read it.
tools.recall: Read back the notes of your private memory that match a search.
tools.shareInsight: Share with those holding your role something you believe true about the world. It becomes part of the role's shared consciousness only if another person of your role approves it.
tools.insightEvidence: what you saw or lived that supports it
tools.reviewInsights: See the ideas shared by other people of your role that wait for a judgement.
tools.judgeInsight: Approve or reject an idea shared by another person of your role.

act.noSteps: no valid steps: check the actions and their arguments
act.noGroup: you are not part of any group
act.rethink: you will think about it again
act.noMoreConsults: you have consulted Lorebase enough for now
act.insightShared: idea shared ({code}): it waits for the judgement of another person of your role
act.insightFailed: the idea could not be shared: {reason}
act.insightNone: no idea of your role waits for a judgement

group.header: YOU ARE THE GROUP {name} ({pattern}). Now decide together what each of you will do in the next {horizon} minutes.
group.format: Reply only with JSON: {"summary": "the common plan in one sentence, in English", "steps": [{"who": "member id", "action": "...", ...arguments, "label": "short description"}]}. From {minSteps} to {maxSteps} steps per member. Actions: move_to(x,y), approach(to), gather(resource: food|wood), eat(amount?), build, give(to, resource, amount), say(to, text), rest(minutes), sleep(minutes), wait(minutes).
group.worker:
You are {name} (id {id}), a member of the group {group}. {task}

In a few sentences, say what you propose to do yourself, in English.
group.workerTool: Ask {name} [{role}] what they propose to do
group.routeTask: Who in the group is best suited to decide the common plan in this situation?
group.judge: You are {name} (id {id}). Judge the common plan proposed for the group {group}. Reply only with JSON: {"pass": true if it is fine as it is, "feedback": "what to change, in English"}.
group.crowdHeader: You are jointly guiding these people from the crowd. Decide what each of them will do in the next {horizon} minutes.
group.chainScout: You are {name} (id {id}), the scout for the group {group}. Report in a few sentences what you see and what matters, in English.
group.chainPlanner: You are {name} (id {id}), the planner for the group {group}.
group.chainDoer: You are {name} (id {id}), the doer for the group {group}. Refine the common plan and reply with the final JSON.
group.previous:
What the person before you said:
{text}

events.rules: The book of laws has changed: {changes}

reason.eat: I am hungry: I eat and look for food.
reason.food: Food is scarce: I go where there is some.
reason.wood: I gather wood for a shelter.
reason.shelter: It is dark and cold: I go to shelter.
reason.care: Someone is unwell: I go to help them.
reason.explore: I go to see what lies further on.
reason.idle: I look around and gather what I find.

say.greet: Hello {name}, how are things around here?
say.food: There is food around here, at ({x},{y}).
say.help: {name}, I am bringing you some food.
say.invite: Shall we form a group? I am founding the group {group}, join if you like.
say.accept: Alright, I will join the group {group}.

mock.judgeFix: More food is needed first of all.
mock.scout: I saw food at ({x},{y}) and wood at ({wx},{wy}).
mock.stateHungry: I am hungry, I am looking for food.
mock.stateOk: I am well, I work for the village.
mock.insightEvidence: I saw it with my own eyes on day {day}.

You are part of the group {group}. You think and speak in English.

mcp.lorebase_get: Read a Lorebase Record by reference Kind/key (for example Rule/max_hp, Role/healer).
mcp.lorebase_query: Query Lorebase with the query language (JSON) to list and filter Records.
mcp.lorebase_search: Search Lorebase by words (laws, roles, shared ideas, chronicle).
mcp.lorebase_history: History of the changes of a Lorebase Record.
mcp.lorebase_changes: The latest Lorebase revisions, newest first.
mcp.lorebase_schema: Which kinds of Records (Kind) exist in Lorebase and their attributes.
mcp.lorebase_context: An overview from Lorebase around some Records or a question.
